name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: At Shael'dryn's direction, Raene's Cleansing now leads you to a mountain shrine with the rebuilt Rod of Dartol. The basin there holds the magic needed to restore its enchantment.

sections.title: A Path into the Heights
sections.body: Shael'dryn sends you from her moonwell into Ashenvale's wild southeastern slopes. The ancient shrines of Ashenvale often stood high among mountain crags, far from roads and hidden beneath dense forest canopies. You must cross unmarked ground along the rock faces and climb winding trails known mostly to Sentinels and woodland hermits.

sections.title: Restoring Dartol's Rod
sections.body: A stone basin waits in a quiet forest alcove. Though dormant, the shrine holds protective magic placed there by night elves long ago. Rest the rebuilt Rod of Dartol in the basin, and the shrine's sleeping power awakens. Its magic flows into the rod, restoring its enchantment so it can cleanse the land.

faq.q: Where is the hidden shrine located?
faq.answer: The shrine lies in the mountains southeast of Shael'dryn's moonwell. Leave the main roads, skirt the rocky cliff faces, and look for a winding path up into the ridges.
Dartol was an evil wizard who created the rod and is now dead. Raene hopes its magic will help investigate the furbolg attacks in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Dartol's Rod need to be placed in the shrine?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn could rebuild the broken rod, but its ancient enchantments had been drained. The hidden shrine holds untouched nature magic that can restore its power.
Shael'dryn is a dryad who lives beside a quiet moonwell in eastern Ashenvale. She helps Raene Wolfrunner research relics and rites that could cleanse the tainted wilderness.

faq.q: What happens after the rod is recharged?
faq.answer: After the shrine restores the rod's power, you can return it to Shael'dryn for use in Raene's investigation of Ashenvale's furbolgs.
The shrine is a peaceful sanctuary, but wild beasts and corrupt furbolg tribes prowl the surrounding mountains and forests, making the climb dangerous.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Ashenvale's hidden mountain shrines as quiet sanctuaries your ancestors made in the wilderness before the modern invasions.
As a druid, you can sense how the shrine's subtle resonance reflects the deep bond between ancient night elven craft and nature's wild energies.
As an Alliance member, you help Raene Wolfrunner secure Astranaar and heal the corrupted lands of northern Kalimdor by restoring this relic.
